_source:
RENAMED (2023 Competency-Based Curriculum's real Mathematics is split into two genuinely separate subjects/syllabi -- 'Mathematics' (Paper I) and 'Mathematics II' (Paper II), confirmed by real Drive material citing two distinctly-named official syllabi, '2024 Mathematics Syllabus' and '2024 Mathematics II Syllabus', with different real topics each). This file's content was previously bundled under the generic subject name 'Mathematics', but its own _source always said it was specifically 'Form 1 Mathematics II Term 3 Scheme of Work' -- it has always been Mathematics II content; only the app's own subject label was wrong. Fixed here: subject renamed to 'Mathematics II', file renamed from mathematics_form1.json to mathematics_ii_form1.json. No topic, sub-topic, competency, objective or week number was added, removed, or altered by this rename.

Original _source, preserved verbatim below:
Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia — 'Form 1 Mathematics II Term 3 Scheme of Work', covering Topics 1.7-1.13 (the syllabus's own numbering; Topics 1.1-1.6 belong to Terms 1-2, not sourced here). The scheme also cites a commercial textbook (Zambia Educational Publishing House, 2024) alongside the CDC syllabus for its assessment/resource suggestions; that citation and a repeated vendor contact footer offering 'editable schemes' have been omitted — this file contains no identifying or promotional information, per this app's standing content policy of crediting only CDC/Ministry of Education. The source PDF's table layout did not extract in strict reading order (rows interleaved across pages); topic/sub-topic/competency groupings below were reconstructed by matching each numbered competency code (1.7.1.1 etc.) to its correct topic based on the code itself and surrounding context, not assumed from extraction order. Week numbers were similarly reconstructed from the scheme's week-range headers (e.g. "1-2", "3-4"), which paced two weeks per topic; the first week of each range is used per sub-topic (the second sub-topic of a pair, where present, takes the following week) — an approximation, not a literal per-row extraction.

A SECOND, DIFFERENT real 'Mathematics 2 Form 1 Scheme of Work, Term 3' (a real Zambian secondary school's Mathematics Department, shared via Drive, citing the real '2024 Mathematics 2 Syllabus STEM Secondary Education Form 1-4') was found while sourcing Mathematics II Form 2 -- it selects a GENUINELY DIFFERENT real topic set for the same Term 3 slot (1.8 Angles and Polygons, 1.9 Financial Arithmetic, 1.10 Directions and Bearings, 1.11 Similarity and Congruency, 1.12 Right Angled Triangles/Pythagoras Theorem, 1.13 Mensuration/The Circle -- versus this file's own 1.7 Relations and Functions through 1.13 Mensuration/Area and Perimeter). Both are real; real teachers legitimately pace and select from the official Mathematics II syllabus's own larger topic pool differently for their own Term 3. Rather than overwrite this file's already-real, already-sourced content with a conflicting real alternative, this discrepancy is documented here transparently and the second document's own content is NOT merged in -- doing so would require deciding whose real selection is 'more correct,' which this app has no basis to do.
